name: hiroura ei
source:
A third-year student and the band's guitarist. Wears gold circle lenses and has tattoos.
Naturally gifted with a charismatic aura.
Outgoing and fearless in social situations, often poking fun at Sugita.
Childhood friends with Kurahashi. Lives with a certain addiction.
